svg.title: Complete EV power train artifact configuration structure
svg.desc: Stakeholder and supplier inputs connect to a six-in-one product with system artifacts and complete MCU, motor, gearbox, OBC, DC-DC and PDU artifact packs. BSW, mechanical structure, mechanical thermal and Systems are generic shared branches. A baseline manifest controls every artifact revision. Twelve typed traceability links are defined in the final panel.
svg.text: EV power train · complete artifact structure
DRAFT · Six-in-one reference configuration · HP / LP selectable · smaller IDT membership remains undefined
Needs · use cases · source clauses + revisions
IDT: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6-in-1 | PF: HP / LP | Baseline ID
Systems branch owns these records; reference them once.
All six component packs use the same artifact pattern, tailored to their engineering scope.
Connections above show hierarchy / allocation. Typed traceability relationships are defined below.
GENERIC SHARED BRANCHES · NO CLASSIFICATION AMONG THE SIX COMPONENTS
Applicable assurance records: safety · cybersecurity · diagnostics · reliability · EMC; linked to requirements and configurations.
BASELINE MANIFEST · CONFIGURATION CONTROL ACROSS THE ENTIRE STRUCTURE
baseline contains exact revisions from all artifact branches
Reverse lookup supports impact and coverage review. Links operate at record / requirement / case level.
Scope: Integration Test and Industrialization excluded. 3/4/5-in-one membership and numeric HP/LP ranges remain to be defined.
Design satisfaction is intent; reviewed execution results provide evidence. Draft artifact pattern, not an approved product baseline.
